messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick thread — follow-up plan for tenants hit by yesterday's onboarding webhook slowdown. Need sign-offs on credits, enablement office hours, and renewal exec note. Draft comm & ask below.
Tom Baker: Sounds good. Recommend two cohorts: high-touch (SLA/near-renewal) and broader self-serve. High-touch get 1:1 office hours + a higher credit.
Ravi Singh: I'll schedule office hours (Tue 10am PST, Wed 4pm CET) and own invites. Need final affected list from infra before we send.
María Gómez: I can draft the renewal exec note — will include risk flag + suggested credit schedule. Also propose a 3-question feedback pulse after the comms (short form).
StatusBot: Incident update — webhook queue lag mitigated at 2025-09-04T02:13Z. Preliminary root cause: retry storm interacting with backfill jobs. Full RCA ETA 48h.
Aisha Patel: Nice. CS Ops — please prep two templates: one brief customer status (neutral, <3 bullets) and one personalized high-touch outreach. Include: 1) What happened, 2) What we fixed, 3) Mitigation & credits + how to sign up for office hours.
Tom Baker: :thumbsup: Will produce cohort counts by EOD. For credits suggestion: prorated credits up to 2 weeks for self-serve, up to one month or customized credit for high-touch accounts.
Ravi Singh: Current counts (pre-final): high-touch = 18 accounts, self-serve impacted ~120. I'll post the CSV to #cs-data and DM infra for last confirmation.
María Gómez: Draft survey link ready to embed: https://forms.gle/short-survey-placeholder — 3 q's: impact severity, resolution satisfaction, ask for follow-up. I'll wire it into the high-touch follow-up email too.
Aisha Patel: Perfect. If infra confirms, we send the self-serve blast at 10:30 PST tomorrow, and invite high-touch to office hours first. Keep tone empathetic, emphasize remediation and next steps. Tag @CS Ops for post-send follow ups + renewal team handoff. :spiral_calendar: :heart:
CS Ops: Copying this and will create the templates + tracking doc. We'll include a column for renewal-risk score and recommended credit. Expect a PR with copy in #cs-drafts by 17:00 PT.
Tom Baker: I'll validate the credit amounts with finance after counts.
Ravi Singh: DMing infra now. Thanks everyone — will update this thread when I have final list.
María Gómez: Adding a short checklist for the comms: 1) Affected scope, 2) RCA summary link, 3) Office hours sign-up, 4) Credit next steps, 5) Feedback form.
Aisha Patel: Thanks team — aim to finalize today so renewals have the exec note before end of week.
